primary_document.title: IMS Nanofabrication GmbH, audit report and financial statements for year ended 31 December 2025
primary_document.access: Public download, no payment or account creation

scope.statement: The Austrian GmbH is wholly owned by IMS Nanofabrication Global LLC. The US sales/service LLC became a sister under the Global holding structure in 2023. These are Austrian UGB entity accounts, not consolidated Intel IMS or All Other segment accounts.

revenue_notes.caution: The note describes the main components rather than a complete reconciliation. Do not equate Austrian revenue with external IMS sales or treat the difference as a separately disclosed business.

issuer_outlook.paraphrase: A competitor gained share; the issuer expects sustained market sharing and makes its longer-term share ambition conditional on better reliability and usability.
Management cites weak conditions, fewer masks for current AI applications, and a competing product as negative influences on incoming orders.
Management expects order recovery only in 2026/27, with earnings effects in following years.

intel_residual_control.limitation: Subtracting Mobileye adjusted profit from Intel aggregate segment profit gives an approximate residual, not audited IMS standalone operating profit. Different adjustments, start-ups and eliminations remain. The $0.7B annual Other-profit policy is close to annualized $0.511B YTD aggregate profit; the Austrian report cautions against presenting its residual as independently proved IMS earnings.

model_recommendation: Retain the aggregate Other policy as an explicitly owned forecast unless replacing it with a complete segment bridge. Remove any assertion that IMS has an uncontested monopoly, mechanically benefits from all AI demand, or independently verifies $0.3B of recurring segment profit. Do not append the Austrian entity profit or revenue to consolidated Intel totals.
source_strength: Original filed issuer report with auditor, primary government identity and filing confirmation, six relevant pages visually checked. Management outlook is dated June 2026 and predates the stronger Intel Q3 figures; it is counterevidence to a blanket narrative, not a November trading update.
